# googleads_campaign_asset (Resource)

Links an asset (sitelink, callout, structured snippet, or anything else from `googleads_*_asset`) to a campaign with a specific `field_type` that tells the API how the asset is used. The triple (campaign, asset, field_type) is immutable; only `status` mutates in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "googleads_campaign_asset" "callout" {
  customer_id = "1234567890"
  campaign_id = googleads_campaign.search.id
  asset_id    = googleads_callout_asset.free_shipping.id
  field_type  = "CALLOUT"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `asset_id` (String) Asset resource name. Immutable.
- `campaign_id` (String) Parent campaign resource name. Immutable.
- `customer_id` (String) Google Ads customer ID.
- `field_type` (String) How the asset is used in the campaign. Common: SITELINK, CALLOUT, STRUCTURED_SNIPPET, MOBILE_APP, CALL, PROMOTION, PRICE, LEAD_FORM. Immutable.

### Optional

- `status` (String) ENABLED (default), PAUSED, or REMOVED.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource name (customers/{cid}/campaignAssets/{campaign_id}~{asset_id}~{field_type}).
